classified_limitations.ctrl_q_gesture: Ctrl+Q was swallowed by the terminal layer and did not reach the TUI. The graceful-quit funnel was verified with SIGTERM, which dispatches the same Action::Quit and Snapshot::take. The UI Ctrl+Q gesture itself is NOT claimed as verified.
classified_limitations.slash_quit: /quit consumes the composer as a slash command, so it is not a valid path for testing draft persistence; this was a harness mistake, not a product failure.
classified_limitations.run_record_race: run_records land asynchronously; an early records[-2] index aborted one phase after Ctrl+O was delivered. The already-delivered insertion was verified from the relay trace and session store without replaying a model request.
classified_limitations.session_sandbox: The agent shell denies /bin/ps and AppleEvents to Terminal, so agent-desktop press --app / screenshot / list-apps time out. Observation used AX snapshots, input used a private CGEvent helper, captures used screencapture -l <window id>, process identity used pgrep/lsof.
